name: Howe Cuts 1830
designer: Individual engravers generally unidentified; several cuts are signed Gilbert, and No. 453 is signed Anderson P.
description: 187 distinct pictorial and emblematic cuts from J. Howe & Co.’s 1830 Philadelphia specimen.
observed: Complete distinct historical cuts. Repeated designs and source impressions are identified in the source inventory.
reconstructed: No invented ornamental content. Recorded crop cleanup excludes neighbouring numbers and isolated scan specks. Measured rigid rotations straighten tilted impressions; uniform scaling preserves proportions.
